editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood pizzeria run by a warm family for two decades, Villa Rosa delivers wood-fired pies and Italian comfort food with genuine hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the deep-crust pepperoni and sausage pizza, and ask about their ribs—longtime owner Maria is known for accommodating special requests and making customers feel like family.

topDishes.note: Tasty and fall off the bone—a 20-year customer's favorite
Perfect sauce-to-cheese ratio, especially with roast beef and red onion
Fantastic and consistently praised by families
